cardTextContent.Pantry: Keep track of all the ingredients you have at home, including their quantities and expiry dates. When you use an ingredient in a recipe, it’s automatically updated, so you always know what’s left.
cardTextContent.MealPlanner: Plan your meals for the week with ease — breakfast, lunch, and dinner all in one place. Pick recipes, organize your days, and never stress about what to cook next.
cardTextContent.RecipeBook: Browse a variety of recipes to suit your taste, mood, and dietary needs. Use filters to find the perfect dish, whether you're cooking with what you have or discovering something new.
